findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products_enriched, get_shipping_rates, complete_checkout, get_page_content, search_docs, get_trust_receipt · Private data: create_cart, get_shipping_rates, select_shipping_option, apply_discount, preview_checkout, complete_checkout, create_sandbox_key, get_trust_receipt · Public sink: complete_checkout, ucp_update_checkout, ucp_complete_checkout, get_page_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products_enriched, get_shipping_rates, complete_checkout, get_page_content, search_docs, get_trust_receipt · Private data: create_cart, get_shipping_rates, select_shipping_option, apply_discount, preview_checkout, complete_checkout, create_sandbox_key, get_trust_receipt · Public sink: complete_checkout, ucp_update_checkout, ucp_complete_checkout, get_page_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
